mapper.select: SELECT a.NO AS activityNo, g.NO AS goalNo, m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID AS chatId, g.COURSE_CODE AS courseCode, a.TITLE AS title, a.GUIDE AS guide, a.MINUTES AS minutes, a.ACT_DATE AS actDate, a.START_TIME AS startTime FROM GOAL_ACTIVITY a JOIN GOAL g ON a.GOAL_NO = g.NO JOIN USER_MEMBER m ON m.ID = g.OWNER_ID JOIN USER_AUTHORITY au ON m.AUTHORITY_NO = au.NO WHERE a.STATUS = 'PLANNED' AND g.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.GOAL_NOTIFY_YN = 1 AND m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID IS NOT NULL AND au.ROLE_NAME = 'USER' AND TIMESTAMP(a.ACT_DATE, a.START_TIME) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM GOAL_NOTICE n WHERE n.KIND = 'REMINDER' AND n.GOAL_NO = g.NO AND n.REF_NO = a.NO AND n.SCHEDULED_AT = TIMESTAMP(a.ACT_DATE, a.START_TIME) AND NOT ( n.STATUS = 'FAILED' AND n.ATTEMPTS < #{maxAttempts} AND n.LAST_ATTEMPT_AT <= #{retryBefore} ) ) ORDER BY a.ACT_DATE, a.START_TIME, a.NO

SELECT g.NO AS goalNo, g.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID AS chatId FROM GOAL g JOIN USER_MEMBER m ON m.ID = g.OWNER_ID JOIN USER_AUTHORITY au ON m.AUTHORITY_NO = au.NO WHERE g.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.GOAL_NOTIFY_YN = 1 AND m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID IS NOT NULL AND au.ROLE_NAME = 'USER' ORDER BY g.NO
